dedupe_keys.name: texas inventory of closed and abandoned municipal solid waste landfills tceq and councils of governments

description: This inventory lists about 4,200 closed and abandoned municipal solid waste landfills across Texas, compiled by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality with the state's 24 regional councils of governments after a 1993 law set requirements for developing land over closed landfills and required regional solid waste plans to include such an inventory. Staff of each council reviewed the entries for their region and the commission approved the regional inventories. The inventory is free to download from the commission's municipal solid waste data page as it was delivered to the councils in the late 1990s, and several councils publish updated regional versions with maps. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the statewide file is historic and has not been maintained centrally, many sites were unpermitted dumps with approximate locations, and absence from the list is not proof that no landfill exists. Simulation uses: flagging legacy landfills in flood, erosion and subsidence exposure studies, screening sites for new infrastructure, and adding ageing waste sites to condition and contamination risk analyses. Related records: the NCTCOG closed landfill inventory (data-nctcog-closed-landfill-inventory) is an updated regional version and the EPA LMOP database (data-epa-lmop-landfill-and-project-database) covers larger landfills nationally.
